settings.bootstrap_seeding: fresh default_rng(seed) per pair x stratum, exactly as one --compare call on the stratum's rows
settings.excluded: composite_score (legacy, ADR 0035 item 4); decomp_mean is computed in the full battery but is in no family
settings.holm: Holm-Bonferroni within each slide family; p basis = exact McNemar for binary metrics, paired t for continuous (the percentile bootstrap emits a CI, not a p). Evaluator verdicts are uncorrected; holm is a separate field.
